example.exampleTitle: Typographic festival poster in 2K with crisp, correctly spelled multi-line text

input.prompt: Design a vertical Swiss-style typographic poster for a fictional open-air film festival. Off-white textured paper background with a subtle halftone grain. The top half is dominated by a huge bold condensed sans-serif headline in deep ultramarine blue that reads "SUMMER NIGHT CINEMA", set on three stacked lines and tightly kerned. Overlapping the headline, a large flat-color shape of a projector beam: a warm orange cone of light spreading diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right, with tiny white dust particles floating inside it. In the lower third, a grid of smaller black text: on the left, "JULY 12-14" in bold with "RIVERSIDE PARK" beneath it; on the right, a column listing "8:30 PM GATES OPEN", "FREE ENTRY" and "BRING A BLANKET". A thin black horizontal rule separates the headline area from the details. At the very bottom, a small line of text reads "THREE NIGHTS / SIX CLASSIC FILMS / ONE BIG SCREEN". Clean alignment on a strict grid, generous margins, flat print-ready colors limited to ultramarine, warm orange, black and off-white. Every word spelled exactly as written, sharp and legible. No people, no logos.

output.alt: Summer Night Cinema poster with blue lettering and a warm orange projector beam

example.exampleTitle: Photorealistic food still life with soft window light, rising steam and fine texture detail

input.prompt: Editorial food photograph of a freshly baked sourdough loaf on a rustic walnut cutting board, shot from a low three-quarter angle. The loaf has a deep mahogany crust with a dramatic curled ear along its single diagonal score, a light dusting of rice flour stenciled in a wheat-stalk pattern on top, and fine blisters across the crust. One end has been sliced off, revealing an open, glossy crumb with irregular airy holes, and a thin wisp of steam rises from the cut face. Beside the board: a folded oatmeal linen cloth, a vintage serrated bread knife with a worn wooden handle, a small ceramic dish holding a curl of pale butter, and a scattering of flour and loose wheat grains on a dark slate tabletop. Soft window light from the right with gentle falloff into a deep charcoal background, warm and moody color grading, shallow depth of field with the crumb in razor-sharp focus. Shot on a 90mm lens, high detail, natural textures. No text, no people, no logos.

output.alt: Freshly sliced sourdough on a wooden board in soft window light

example.exampleTitle: Flat-vector educational infographic with accurate labels and a clear step-by-step flow

input.prompt: A clean educational infographic illustration titled "HOW RAIN IS MADE" in bold rounded dark-navy letters across the top. Flat vector style with soft gradients on a pale sky-blue background. The scene is a simple landscape cross-section: a turquoise lake at the lower left, rolling green hills and a small pine forest in the middle, a snow-capped mountain on the right, and a stylized warm-yellow sun in the upper left. Four numbered stages connected by curved dashed arrows form a loop: 1 "EVAPORATION" with wavy vapor lines rising from the lake; 2 "CONDENSATION" with a fluffy white cloud forming above; 3 "PRECIPITATION" with a gray cloud releasing blue raindrops over the mountain; 4 "COLLECTION" with a river flowing from the mountain back into the lake. Each stage label sits in a white rounded tag next to a small numbered circle. Friendly, uncluttered children's science textbook look with consistent line weight. Every word spelled exactly as written. No people, no logos.

output.alt: How Rain Is Made infographic with a labeled four-stage water cycle

example.exampleTitle: Restyle a daytime living room into a firelit winter cabin while keeping the armchair and camera angle

input.prompt: Keep the armchair's exact shape, walnut frame and position and the same camera angle, but transform the whole scene into a cozy mountain cabin on a winter night. Reupholster the armchair in deep emerald-green velvet with a soft sheen. Replace the white walls with warm honey-toned log walls, change the view through the window to falling snow over dark pine trees under a deep blue night sky, and add a stone fireplace with a crackling fire at the right edge of the room. Drape a chunky cream knit blanket over one armrest, replace the ceramic cup with a steaming mug of hot cocoa, and lay a soft sheepskin rug under the chair. Relight everything with warm, flickering firelight from the right and a cool blue glow from the window, with realistic shadows and reflections.

output.alt: Emerald velvet armchair beside a glowing fireplace in a snowy mountain cabin
The original armchair in a bright room with white walls
